ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:20 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (localized spots) to low-intensity dark-grey/black pixels (primary surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-grey surface area covering approximately 90% of visible fluke, with discrete high-contrast white circular spots (2-8 pixels diameter) scattered across the mid-to-lower visible regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge displays high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth serrations. Left (upper) lobe displays irregular, high-amplitude jagged interruptions and missing pixel segments relative to a smooth curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a parabolic convex sweep from the notch to the distal tip. The left (upper) lobe follows a truncated, irregular convex path.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of approximately 10-15 white circular pixel clusters, likely indicative of previous barnacle attachments, distributed primarily on the lower half of the dark surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme irregularity and jagged pixel loss on the distal tips of both lobes; presence of brownish-orange high-contrast material attached to the extreme edge of the upper lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple Procellariidae (seabirds) in the immediate foreground and background of the whale's fluke.
